label: ProgressRing

leaf.lead: ProgressRing is a percentage, or the way towards a goal, as a ring: a gray track and an arc that grows clockwise from twelve o'clock when it comes into view (or its Step lights up), with the figure counting up in the centre and an optional caption under it.
